title: Book Three · Chapter 180: Six Hours Between
story:
In November, Ronan and Anna visit the station after school.

They have two city names on a small sheet. Today they want the route between those places.

The woman at the window looks through the company's printed guide. Ronan waits while Anna holds the page flat on the counter.

“There is a direct bus,” the woman says. “About six hours.”

She shows them the route.

“Sixteen yuan one way at present.”

Ronan writes it down. Anna checks the two names again.

“Thirty-two for there and back?”

“Yes. Ask again near your travel date.”

They thank her and move away from the window. A man behind them steps forward with his bag.

Outside, Ronan looks at the numbers.

Six hours each way. Twelve hours for the two journeys, as well as the time together.

“A long weekend,” he says.

Anna nods. She takes the pencil and writes return beside the thirty-two.

“And that is only the bus.”

“I know.”

For a little while, they watch people cross the station yard.

“I want to try when we know the class times,” he says.

“Me too. We need to see the timetables first.”

She puts the pencil back in his hand.

“They still need to write to us.”

Ronan smiles. They have bought no tickets today.

He folds the route note and puts it in his own folder. Anna takes his hand as they walk toward the market road.

At the bread shop corner, she asks about his new phrase book. He gives her one question from its visitor page.

She answers, then changes the time in the next sentence. Ronan catches the change and gives a different answer.

“Better,” she says.

“A slower customer.”

She laughs and walks a little faster. He follows her for three steps, then catches up beside her again.

At the end of November, Mum and Dad make their next study payment. Dad adds twelve yuan and Mum eight.

The parents now keep one hundred and eighty. Ronan still has sixty-nine from work and twenty and a half from the book sale. The three amounts total two hundred and sixty-nine and a half.

He puts the route note behind his first-term cost sheet. Visits need their own plan later.

Then he clears his school pages for the final weeks of the local term. There is one written task left before Friday, and he starts it while the evening light is still good.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

direct＝直达的；guide＝线路指南；return＝往返、回程；catch up＝赶到同一位置。

## 理解问题

1. 目前两个候选城市间车程和单程、往返车费各是多少？今天有没有买票或保证每周见面？
2. 十一月底父母实际加存后，三份钱合计多少？会面的车费是否已从中扣除？

## 读句子

**She puts the pencil back in his hand.**

拆开看：She / puts the pencil back / in his hand.

她／把铅笔放回／他的手里。
